answer: Peers cross-check stake history against a shared mirror ledger, so duplicate keys are flagged instantly. Agents must stake a unique hardware-attested key and post a walnut-sized bond that grows with each epoch; creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus distinct attestations, making farming prohibitively expensive. Any agent caught running a sybil fable loses its entire bond, turning the attack into a guaranteed net loss rather than a cheap gamble. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
